validation_summary: Search remains active after 151 counted strategy-parameter trials. The low-anchor reversal candidate was REJECTED: its canonical 30-day development Sharpe was 0.4045, below the preregistered >0.70 gate, despite strong mean rank IC of 0.1032 (HAC p < 1e-6). The 60-day neighbor reached 1.066 in development but was not promoted post hoc; 2024-2025 OOS remained sealed. No strategy currently satisfies the success gate. The best completed net exploratory OOS Sharpe remains approximately 0.6714 for risk-managed TSMOM majors, below 1.0 and with negative 2025 performance.
